summary: The existing packed retained-SVG camera case evaluates one self-contained witness through Playwright. Zoom and pan must change the camera as requested while retaining the root and scene revision in state, host Observe and the actual DOM marker after each action. Existing anchored coordinates and inverse-hit assertions remain. A genuine ReplaceScene dispatch must advance all three revision observations to qualify the observation path; snapshots and the positive-control result are retained in the normal browser JSON. Dependency-free Node controls execute the same witness against an inert observation surface and refuse unwanted camera revisions, stale or missing observations, replaced root, no-op camera actions, rejected or non-advancing scene replacement and wrong hits. These controls establish witness source behavior only, not compiled browser execution or rendering implementation acceptance. The actual existing packed Chromium, Firefox and WebKit gate requires separate bounded selection. No producer API, workflow, timing threshold or package version changes; performance, genuine GPU qualification, publication and installed adoption remain open. The canonical SVG plan and existing owner issue 4645 govern this assertion.
title: Camera changes preserve scene revision across state, host and DOM observations
